summary: Verified redesigned Admin Dashboard drawer + summary chips + stat grid. Backend 10/10 pytest admin_access passing: admin login (Vibe@2026 & empty), /api/auth/me role=admin, GET /api/admin/stats returns all required keys incl. guest_plays/logged_plays/total_transactions/revenue/currency/top_songs/recent_transactions (401 no token, 403 non-admin), admin CRUD (albums/songs/users) 200, 403 for non-admin. Frontend (mobile 390x844): guest /admin gate shows admin-login button and routes to /(auth)/login. After admin login, /admin header shows hamburger (admin-menu) + 'Admin Dashboard' + home (admin-back). Summary chips card renders '46 guests · 60 plays · 16 payments' and 'TZS 8,000 raised · 45 users'. All 12 stat cards present (stat-users..stat-revenue). Drawer opens on admin-menu tap, showing all 4 group headers (Reports & Analytics, Contents, Control & Management, System). Tapping 'Live Radio' (placeholder) closes drawer without crash. menu-content -> Content tab (admin-add-album/song visible). menu-users -> Users tab. menu-overview -> Overview stat grid restored. drawer-close hides drawer. No red screen, no console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: admin/index.tsx: MENU items with the same tab (e.g. Dashboard/Analytics/Revenue/Transactions all -> overview; App Users/Admin Users -> users) produce duplicate testIDs (menu-overview x4, menu-users x2). Testing works via .first, but consider unique testIDs like menu-<label-slug> to allow targeting individual rows for future analytics/revenue screens.
Placeholder items rely on it.tab || it.label for testID; label with spaces becomes 'menu-Live Radio' which is fine as a data-testid but unconventional. Slugifying (menu-live-radio) would be cleaner.
chipsRow uses <Text> containing nested <Text> for chip number + label — works on RN Web but on native the outer parent Text may inherit styling; verified rendering OK in web preview.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral TEST_ album/song and TEST_nonadmin user created and cleaned inside pytest run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin dashboard drawer redesign is stable. Duplicate testIDs (menu-overview, menu-users) exist by design when multiple menu items map to the same tab — target via locator.first. Placeholder menu items (Live Radio, Neno, Bible, Churches, Religious Leaders, Choir, Donations, Subscriptions, Settings, Feedback) intentionally show 'Inakuja hivi karibuni' toast and close the drawer, per product decision.
